The mark after "nunquam" and after "sum." is a printed line or hook, not a letter. The top line is a fragment that starts mid-sentence. No page number or running head is visible. The Greek word after "Si vero" is doubtful and may be misprinted. The left-margin marks beside "Conscientia" and "Sed quia" have no note text in this part of the page. The paragraph break before "Conscientia enim" is uncertain. The line ends after "bonum." at the full measure, so I read it as continuous. Two reference marks in the left margin may carry notes that appear elsewhere on the scan.
